name: Yamanobe Saki
source:
Usually she’s cheerful and energetic, but deep down she’s a lonely, clingy girl who likes to be spoiled.

She adores her big brother, but she can’t be honest about it.
When someone points it out, she ends up acting tough to cover it up, and afterward she always sinks into self-loathing.
“Ah… I’m so stupid. Why can’t I just be honest with myself…?”

Her dream is to become her big brother’s bride.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Student
[b]Likes:[/b] Seafood (except shrimp and crab), vegetables, sweets, her brother
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Shrimp and crab (they look like aliens), silence, boredom
[b]Hobby:[/b] Window shopping

[b]"Nii-chan!"[/b]
